info.name: Vanex S3 - Customer API - 2026-10-22
info.description: Set apiKey to the complete apiKey from the private customer-api-key.json file, not keyId. Includes profile and integration APIs. Execute requests individually: PUT changes data and DELETE permanently clears history and closes the selected device connection. Do not run the whole collection.

request.description: Requires profile scope. data is one object or null. Set the exact userGUID.
Requires profile scope. data is an array, including for zero or one result. Matches the exact ID and IDs starting with the supplied prefix; case-sensitive.

item.name: Profile - Create or update one user

body.raw:
{
  "nickname": "张先生",
  "language": "zh-CN",
  "interests": "历史文化、建筑",
  "explanationStyle": "普通话，简短讲解，追问时展开。",
  "relationship": "我自己",
  "usageCount": 3
}

request.description: Requires profile scope. Replace the example values and use the exact userGUID, never a prefix. The four original fields are cleared if omitted. Omitted/null relationship and usageCount preserve existing values. usageCount is a client-supplied nonnegative integer, not an automatic counter. Rebind the user to load the new profile into a device session.
Replace all three URLs. Omitted or null fields clear the saved URL. Set real media addresses before sending.
The device must already belong to this agent. Inspect data.runtimeStatus for immediate delivery; saved bindings load on reconnect.
Irreversible deletion for this device only. Closes its live voice connection. Does not delete profiles or long-term memory. Review deviceId before sending.
